decision.title: Name pool in comparisons; record entries may fail (P2, P3)

body.p: by packet , on the orchestrator's acceptance of P2 and P3 (design edits to include/sxml/xdm.h).

item.p: P2 accepted: sxml_atomic_comparison gains const sxml_name_pool *name_pool, NULL allowed when no xs:QName or xs:NOTATION is compared (a pool, not the heap: ordering names needs nothing else). sxml_atomic_item_compare now orders QNames by namespace URI, then local name (F&O 4.0, fn:compare, PR2256); two different names without a pool give SXML_STATUS_INVALID_ARGUMENT. The internal sxml_atomic_item_compare_in_heap stays (it uses the heap's pool, else the comparison's) because src/xdm_internal.h is not this packet's; it can go when 1.7's files are next edited.

P3 accepted, option "document": the contract of sxml_map_get_entry states that the first call on a record may return the heap's failures (OUT_OF_MEMORY, LIMIT_EXCEEDED), since record keys are made lazily (); sxml_map_find and sxml_json_node_make_child already list them.
